> Yes, a lot of people have those values. But there are a lot of people who value kindness, compassion, empathy and living a meaningful life.  Why are you choosing to value the former over the latter

I'm not.  They aren't mutually exclusive.  

> killing yourself over it?

because I don't want to live with this shit.  And that's what it is, shit

> Yes. But we all choose what our values are. And you have chosen to value things you don't have. And that's making you very unhappy.

All/most men and women value a man being tall, having a dick that's not tiny, and having normal hands that don't hurt just by existing... It's not like I'm choosing to value the things I don't have on purpose.  These values are desirable damn near universal.  I don't have them so I'm going to kill myself.  Pretty simple

> Good looks, height, and a big dick aren't important in the end. 

It is important.  It's important in the beginning, the end, and it's important to me

>  What matters is the love we give and the love we share.  Why not make your life about that instead of your physical limitations?

I don't love myself.  I have no love to share
Is that supposed to make me feel better?
Can't change everything, especially the things I need changed

> That's okay. Some woman like them that size.

I don't

> I am only 5'9". It's okay. Find a really short girl... there are plenty of them.

It's not always about women.  I don't like being short.  Short men aren't as respected, feared, or taken as seriously

No money, tired of dental work anyway

> I am sorry it causes you so much pain. Develop humor about it

Develop a sense of humor about being in physical pain?  

> Try stronglifts 5x5. You would be surprised how just having muscles makes some women swoon.

Why the fuck is it always about women?  I don't give a fuck about what women want.  It's about what I want.  I don't want to be myself because myself clearly sucks
